compute.run_notes: The counted run is two passes, 2026-10-15 14:26-14:52Z and 14:54-15:02Z: the first ran without ffmpeg on PATH, so the codec condition was decoded in the second. Not counted: two earlier attempts (14:13-14:20Z, five runs side by side, and 14:21-14:25Z, which read the noise pool once per recording) ran the box out of RAM and were stopped, about 0.2 h; their decodes were kept, as the run resumes.

noise.licence: per recording (Freesound: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-3.0/4.0, CC-BY-NC-3.0/4.0, CC-Sampling+)
noise.segment: one recording and offset per clip (noise_draw), looped
noise.snr: clip mean power over the noise segment's

reverb.level: scaled back to the clean clip's RMS
reverb.tail: Gaussian, drawn per clip, decaying 60 dB over the RT60

sample.rule: eligible dev clips ranked by sha256(seed:d2-sample:filename), first size
